title: fix(cli,vscode-extension,components,runner): move the `body` child-list dialect off the platform’s producers, and teach the two VS Code readers `children`
body:
Fixes #7181

Clause-②: no

Moves the `body` child-list dialect off the platform's PRODUCERS, and — per the seat's
ruling of 2026-09-18T09:03Z on the card — converges the two VS Code extension readers
onto `children` first so the producers can move at all.

## Why the reader change is here and not in a later step

The card's delivery order asked for a stop condition first: does every face the
producers' output crosses accept `children` today? Five of six did. The two extension
readers did not — they guarded on `schema.body` alone, so moving the producers without
them would have shipped a blank preview. That was measured before any producer moved,
reported, and ruled on; the amended fence added exactly those two files.

**The reader fix is a live defect fix in its own right, true today with no part of the
retirement being true.** An author spelling a child list `children` — blessed by the
`BaseSchema` declaration, the zod mirror, core's `validateSchema` and the authoring
tier's `BASE_PROPS` — got a silently blank preview and children that were never
validated. That is what the changeset names.

## What changed

**Readers** (`children` first, `body` KEPT — purely additive, nothing narrowed):

- `packages/vscode-extension/src/providers/PreviewProvider.ts` — the card branch and the
  default container branch
- `packages/vscode-extension/src/providers/SchemaValidator.ts` — the recursion guard, and
  the diagnostic path now names the key the document actually used instead of addressing
  problems to `.body[...]` in a file containing no such key

**Producers** (node counts as `pnpm census:body-dialect` reports them):

| producer | nodes |
|:--|--:|
| `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts` | 53 |
| `packages/vscode-extension/src/extension.ts` | 14 |
| `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/carousel.tsx` | 3 |
| `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/resizable.tsx` | 2 |
| `packages/runner/src/App.tsx` | 2 |
| `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/scroll-area.tsx` | 1 |

Every node type involved (`div`, `card`, `page`) already read `children`, so this is a
rename, not a re-shape.

## Evidence

**The executed probe that decided the stop**, run against the preview's own shipped
inline renderer extracted verbatim: the same `card` node printed `descendant elements
rendered: 2` under `body` and `1` under `children`. The `body` leg is the lit control in
the same run, so the `1` is a real drop. That probe is now a committed test rather than a
one-off.

**Five ablations, each proving a pin can fail** (via `ablation-replace`, which asserts the
mutation landed by blob hash and proves the restore against `HEAD`):

| ablated | result |
|:--|:--|
| preview container arm | 3 red — `expected +0 to be 1` |
| preview card arm | 2 red |
| validator arm | 1 red — `expected [] to include 'Missing required property "type"'` |
| `init.ts` simple template back to `body` | 1 red — names the retired dialect |
| `extension.ts` empty template back to `body` | 1 red |

Every restore leg reported `blob == HEAD` with an empty `git diff HEAD`, and the tree was
clean after all five.

**Census before and after**, same instrument, same root:

```
nodes carrying `body`   230  becomes  160
```

That reconciles exactly: 230 − 75 migrated + 5 deliberately kept. The 5 are `body`-spelled
fixtures in the new pins, which assert BOTH spellings so a regression in the kept `body`
arm is caught too. All six producer files are absent from the after-census; the control is
that the census still reports 195 rows elsewhere in the same run.

**Suites and gates** (all on the final tree):

| check | result |
|:--|:--|
| `vitest run packages/cli/ packages/vscode-extension/ packages/runner/` | 27 files, 316 tests pass |
| `vitest run packages/components/` | 281 files, 2744 tests pass |
| `turbo run type-check` (4 touched packages) | 19/19 tasks pass |
| `check-changeset-presence` | pass — 11 source files, 4 released packages, 1 changeset |
| `check-changeset-no-major` | pass |
| `check-control-bytes` | pass |
| `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` | 0 new |
| `check-governed-queue-guard --test` | NOT GOVERNED, 12 paths checked |
| `eslint --no-inline-config` over the 11 changed files | exit 0, 0 errors, 15 warnings, **0 of them on a line this branch added** |

The lint run is narrowed to the changed files. Stated so it can be checked: the repo's
eslint config declares no `project` / `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off and
this diff cannot move the verdict on any file it does not touch; the file count is from
`--format json`.

⚠️ `type-check` earned its place here. The first version of the reader comments put raw
backticks inside the preview's HTML template literal, which ends the string. Every test
stayed green — the pins read that provider as TEXT rather than importing it — and only
`tsc` caught it. Fixed in its own commit, and the ablation was re-run afterwards to
confirm it still bites.

## Seat note — evidence is UNDERSTATED above, and one CI repair round happened

⚠️ **Added by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat** (`session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`), 2026-09-18T10:18Z. The dev writes a PR body once and ⛔ never patches it; the body is the seat's to keep current.

**The Evidence table above cites 27+281 test files across four packages. That is now conservative, ⛔ not wrong.** After a CI repair round the branch is verified over **719 test files / 15139 tests across SEVEN trees** — `scripts/`, `examples/` and `packages/types/` added — plus `tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json` with the edited file proven inside that program by `--listFiles`.

**Why the repair round happened, and ⭐ what it found.** CI went red on `Test (shard 3/4)`: `scripts/__tests__/body-dialect-census.test.ts` pins that the producers **still carry `body`** — this card's own finding, written down as a test — so migrating them reds it. ⛔ That is the pin doing its job, and it is 100% this PR's to repair. The repair keeps the block's claim **verbatim** and re-points its subject at objectui#9847; ⛔ it was deliberately **not** inverted into 「the producers now carry `children`」, which would assert this branch's own diff back at itself and discard the ordering rationale.

⭐⭐ **And the mandatory ablation caught a PHANTOM PASS inside that repair.** The strengthened reader assertion did ⛔ not bite: ablating the `children` arm out of `providers/SchemaValidator.ts` left the pin **GREEN**, because that file **documents** the arm by quoting `schema.children || schema.body` in a comment directly above the line that implements it — `toContain` was matching the **prose**, not the code. Fixed with a `readCode` helper that strips whole-line comments only (so a `//` inside a string survives: both a URL and the preview provider's inlined webview script appear in the files these blocks read). ⚠️ **Invisible to the assertion's own result — green before and after the mutation — and only an ablation shows it.** Without the mandatory ablation this would have shipped as a pin that could never fail.

⭐ The instrument that found the red's siblings is worth naming: instead of guessing which trees to sweep, the dev grepped for **every test anywhere that names one of the changed source files**, control lit in the same run. It returned readers in **three** trees no affected-package suite reaches — `scripts/` (the census pin), `packages/types/` (two pins reading `carousel.tsx` and `resizable.tsx`) and `examples/schema-catalog/` (one reading `scroll-area.tsx`).

## Acceptance notes

- **There is a SEVENTH producer this PR does not touch, and it is now FILED as objectui#9847.**
  `generatePage()` in `packages/cli/src/commands/generate.ts:72` does `writeFileSync` of a
  `pages/NAME.json` carrying a `body` child list (`:80`) — a producer in exactly the card's
  sense, and the census places it in the same `app-metadata` bucket the six were in. It is
  outside the amended fence, and the bounded in-place exemption does not apply because a dev
  cannot amend the claim's declared file surface. Listed, not touched; it is the one
  `app-metadata` row the after-census still reports. ⭐ Re-measured at source by the seat on
  `origin/main` `276d1745` before filing, control lit in the same run.
  ⚠️ **The repaired census pin names that card in-source**, so objectui#9847 landing will red
  `the platform SHIPS the dialect it is being asked to refuse` until the block is re-pointed —
  at whatever still ships the dialect, or at nothing once nothing does, **which is the day
  objectui#6771 step 4 becomes landable.** That is the intended handoff, ⛔ not a trap.
- The card's own producer table prints **1** node for `packages/runner/src/App.tsx`; the
  census counts **2** (a `page` node and the `div` nested in it). The migration used 2.
  Table inaccuracy on the card, not a code defect.
- The card cites `schema-validator.ts:419`; it is at `:467` on this base. Not repaired —
  cross-file line addresses are repaired opportunistically and never as a sweep, and a
  card body is record.
- Commit trailers here follow this repo's observed convention on `main`
  (`Co-authored-by: Claude`), which is model-free. Noted because the session's default
  attribution names a model.

## Not in this PR, deliberately

- `packages/core/src/validation/schema-validator.ts` — already `children`-first; removing
  its `body` arm belongs to the retirement's reader-convergence step, not here.
- `packages/types/src/base.ts` and its zod mirror — the published-type narrowing step.
  Both already accept `children`; nothing to change.
- Corpus and teaching.
- The `body` arm itself, anywhere. Nothing in this branch narrows an accept set.

Part of the retirement tracked on objectui#6771; that card is not addressed here and
remains open.
